"""End-to-end campaign: many random instances, independent verification."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")
import gen, gen2, extreme, boundary, check

PLANNER = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "/app/submission/planner.py"


def build(rng, n):
    reqs = []
    i = 0
    while len(reqs) < n:
        i += 1
        kind = i % 5
        try:
            if kind == 0:
                r = gen.gen(rng)
            elif kind == 1:
                r = gen2.gen(rng)
            elif kind == 2:
                r = extreme.extreme(rng, rng.choice(["maxcap", "cap1", "parallel", "zeroheavy"]))
            elif kind == 3:
                base = gen2.gen(rng)
                base["budget"] = 98304
                base["failed_edges"] = []
                if boundary.min_migration_and_mlu(base) is None:
                    continue
                kk = rng.choice(["budget_tight", "budget_short", "cap_exact", "cap_over"])
                r = boundary.variant(base, rng, kk)
                if r is None:
                    continue
            else:
                r = gen2.gen(rng, mode=rng.choice(["big", "star"]))
        except Exception as e:
            continue
        reqs.append(r)
    return reqs


def main(seed, n):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    reqs = build(rng, n)
    payload = "".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in reqs).encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, PLANNER], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=850)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("PLANNER CRASH rc=%s" % p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
        return 1
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    if len(lines) != len(reqs):
        print("line count mismatch", len(lines), len(reqs), p.stderr.decode()[-1000:])
        return 1
    fails = 0
    stats = {}
    for i, (req, line) in enumerate(zip(reqs, lines)):
        try:
            resp = json.loads(line)
        except Exception as e:
            print("bad json line %d: %r" % (i, line[:200])); fails += 1; continue
        stats[resp.get("status")] = stats.get(resp.get("status"), 0) + 1
        if resp.get("status") == "invalid":
            print("UNEXPECTED INVALID case %d: %s" % (i, json.dumps(req)[:300]))
            fails += 1
            continue
        errs = check.check(req, resp, verbose=False)
        if errs:
            fails += 1
            print("case %d FAILED %s" % (i, errs))
            print("   req:", json.dumps(req)[:400])
            if fails > 5:
                break
    print("campaign seed=%s n=%d time=%.1fs fails=%d stats=%s" % (seed, n, dt, fails, stats))
    if p.stderr.strip():
        print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:600])
    return fails


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1
    n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 200
    sys.exit(1 if main(seed, n) else 0)
PYEOF
